title: 67 (Six Seven)
blurb: Six... seven! The two numbers that broke a generation. Born from Skrilla's track and turbocharged by basketball edits playing on the height 6'7", it became Gen Alpha's inside joke — a call-and-response chant with an accompanying hand gesture, screamed across classrooms worldwide until teachers began confiscating the concept itself. It means nothing. It means everything. Ask a child what 67 means and watch them genuinely short-circuit attempting to explain, because there is no explanation, only participation. That gap between how much they care and how little it signifies is peak brainrot, perfectly preserved.
origin: From Skrilla's 'Doot Doot (6 7)', amplified by basketball edits into a global Gen Alpha chant.
